questions.stem: What does the discriminant $b^2 - 4ac$ tell us about a quadratic equation?

options.text: The number and type of roots
Whether the parabola opens up or down

questions.explanation: If $b^2 - 4ac > 0$, there are two distinct real roots. If $b^2 - 4ac = 0$, there is one repeated root. If $b^2 - 4ac < 0$, there are no real roots.
